mapper.select: WITH RECURSIVE unit_tree AS ( SELECT unit_id, parent_id FROM base_work_unit WHERE unit_id = #{rootUnitId} AND status = '0' UNION ALL SELECT child.unit_id, child.parent_id FROM base_work_unit child JOIN unit_tree parent ON child.parent_id = parent.unit_id WHERE child.status = '0' ) SELECT unit_id FROM unit_tree
